newsitem.title: USA: LSB Industries sees Q1 loss.
newsitem.headline: LSB Industries sees Q1 loss.

text.p: LSB Industries Inc said Tuesday that preliminary indications are that while sales for the first quarter will increase about six percent from a year earlier, it will record a loss for the quarter.
It said the loss will primarily be a result of lower than expected margins in its chemical business and losses in its industrial and automotive products businesses.
LSB said margins in its chemical business were lower than normal as a result of sustained high raw material and natural gas costs.
The company said the entire automotive parts industry is undergoing consolidation that is expected to work in the company's favor.

LSB said it is continuing to achieve reductions in inventories of both its automotive and industrial products businesses, with a $5.5 million reduction in 1996 and an additional $7.0 million anticipated reduction in 1997.
LSB said it expects to announce first quarter results around the first week of May.
